expectedResults: The saved profile is not silently reinterpreted and a clear mismatch warning appears before playback.
objective: Verify a profile retains its own tuning-system and reference-pitch context and warns before playback when that context differs from the current selection.
steps: Save a profile, change the current tuning system or reference pitch, then select the profile for playback.
title: Profile tuning-reference retention and mismatch warning
